items.q: Is Prospecting Call Tracker a CRM or a consulting company?
items.a: Both. The software is a prospecting-first CRM for real estate agents and teams. The consulting side helps you build the routine, standards, scripts and follow-up plans that make the software pay off. You can use either one, or both together.

items.q: Do I have to buy leads from you?
items.a: No. The system is built to work the property data and contacts you already have or choose to buy — probate, absentee, expired, FSBO, circle prospecting, past clients and more. We help you decide which lists are worth paying for.

items.q: Does the AI send messages on its own?
items.a: No. The AI assistant reads, drafts, ranks and summarizes. A person reviews every suggested text or email and clicks Approve before anything goes out. It never places calls or changes Do Not Call or consent settings.

items.q: Can agents see each other's leads?
items.a: Only if you allow it. Leads are assigned to agents, and team owners control who can see, edit, export or reassign leads through roles and permissions.

No one honestly can. Results vary and depend on effort, market conditions, lead quality, and follow-up. What we provide is the system, the tracking and the coaching to make consistent prospecting easier to do and easier to measure.

features.title: Prospecting Lists
features.text: Upload CSV or Excel lists from your data provider, map the columns once and save the mapping for next time. Organize leads by list — probate, absentee, expired, FSBO, circle — with statuses, tags and custom fields. Sort Data helps you find, sort, move and copy leads across lists and teams.

features.title: Lead Assignment and Data Protection
features.benefit: Every lead has an owner, and your data stays yours.
features.text: Assign whole lists or individual leads to one or more agents. With agent data isolation turned on, agents see only the leads assigned to them, while team leaders see their team. Viewing phone numbers, exporting and reassigning are permissions you control.

features.title: Dialer and Call Tracking
features.text: Work a list from the call queue: the next lead loads with their numbers, history and notes. Log the outcome in one tap and every call is counted toward the agent's activity. Connect your own phone provider for in-browser calling, or tap-to-call from your phone.

features.title: Text Messaging Workspace
features.benefit: Keep every text conversation with the lead it belongs to.
features.text: Two-way texting in a shared inbox tied to each lead. Opt-out words like STOP are handled automatically, consent is tracked per number, and sending windows keep messages within the hours you set. Requires your own texting provider account.

features.title: Email Follow-Up Center
features.benefit: Professional email follow-up without another tool.
features.text: Send and receive email from the CRM with a template library, campaigns to a list or segment, and analytics for deliveries, opens, clicks and replies. Replies land in the lead's thread, and unsubscribes are honored automatically.

features.title: Smart Plans and Automated Follow-Ups
features.benefit: The second, third and tenth touch actually happen.
features.text: Build step-by-step follow-up plans — email, wait, call task, text task — and enroll leads by hand or by rule. Ready-made starting points include probate, new seller, open house and past-client plans. Plans stop when a lead replies or unsubscribes.

features.title: AI Prospecting Assistant
features.benefit: A second set of hands that never acts on its own.
features.text: The assistant drafts texts and emails, summarizes a lead's history, and suggests next steps. It only sees what the signed-in person is allowed to see. Every suggestion waits for a person to review and click Approve — it never sends messages, places calls, or changes consent. Uses your own AI provider account, with an on/off switch and a budget.

features.title: CRM Pipeline
features.benefit: See every opportunity from first conversation to closing.
features.text: Move deals through seller and buyer pipeline stages you define, with deal values, assigned agents and history. Pipelines can be set per team.

features.title: Follow-Up Queue
features.benefit: Today's follow-ups, in order, every morning.
features.text: One list of what's due today and what's overdue — follow-ups, call tasks and text tasks from Smart Plans — so agents start the day knowing exactly who to contact.

features.title: Team Scoreboard
features.benefit: Friendly competition, based on real activity.
features.text: A weekly scoreboard ranks agents on points from calls, texts, door knocks, conversations and appointments. You choose the point values and the weekly goal.

features.title: Agent KPIs
features.text: Per-agent dials, conversations, appointments and conversion rates over the week or month, compared with the period before.

features.title: Lead Source ROI Tracking
features.benefit: Know which lists are worth paying for.
features.text: Compare lead sources by contacts, conversations, appointments, deals and dollars, so you can put your budget behind the sources that produce listings for your team.

features.title: Team Roles and Permissions
features.benefit: Give everyone exactly the access they need.
features.text: Owner, administrator, team leader and agent roles with fine-grained permissions. Team panels keep each team's leads, lists, settings and reports separate, while the Owner sees the whole company.

features.title: Reporting and Coaching Dashboard
features.benefit: Run your weekly meeting from one screen.
features.text: The team dashboard brings together activity, follow-up completion, pipeline and scoreboard trends so leaders can spot who needs help and celebrate who's improving.

about.founderTitle: Founder, Prospecting Call Tracker · Real estate agent and team leader
story: Prospecting Call Tracker was built by a real estate agent and team leader with more than seven years of experience in the business. The founder built his real estate career through outbound prospecting, cold calling, open houses, consistent follow-up, system building, and team accountability.

After seeing how many agents lose opportunities because their leads are disorganized, their follow-up is inconsistent, or their team lacks a clear process, he began building systems to solve those problems.

Prospecting Call Tracker combines real-world real estate experience with technology, AI, and practical coaching to help agents and teams work smarter, protect their leads, and create more consistent business.

seo.title: Privacy Policy — Prospecting Call Tracker
seo.description: How Prospecting Call Tracker collects, uses and protects information.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.draftNote: Draft — have your attorney review before relying on this policy.

p: Prospecting Call Tracker (“we”, “us”) provides prospecting software and consulting services for real estate professionals. This policy explains what information we collect through this website and our services, how we use it, and the choices you have.

When you fill out a form on this website we collect what you enter: your name, email address, phone number, brokerage or team name, number of agents, current CRM, your prospecting challenges, which services you're interested in, and which page or button you came from.

If you become a customer, we also process the information you and your team put into the software, such as lead lists, notes, call and message history. You control that data; we process it to provide the service.

Like most websites, our hosting provider records basic technical information such as IP address, browser type and pages visited, for security and reliability. If analytics are turned on, we use them to understand which pages are useful; we do not sell this information.
To respond to your request, schedule demos and calls, provide and support our services, improve this website, keep our systems secure, and meet legal obligations.

If you check the consent box on a form, you agree that we may contact you about your request by phone call, text message and email. Message and data rates may apply. Consent is not a condition of purchase. You can opt out of texts at any time by replying STOP, and unsubscribe from emails using the link in any email. We record your consent and opt-outs and honor them.

We use third-party providers for hosting, databases, email delivery, phone calling, text messaging and AI features. They process information on our behalf under their own terms and security practices. Phone, text, AI, data and hosting provider fees may be separate from our fees.
Where AI features are used, information is sent to the AI provider only as needed to produce a draft or summary, and a person reviews AI suggestions before anything is sent.
We don't sell your personal information. We share it only with service providers who help us operate, when required by law, or as part of a business transfer.
We use reasonable safeguards such as encryption in transit, access controls and audit logs. We keep information as long as needed for the purposes above or as required by law.
You can ask us to access, correct or delete your information, or to stop contacting you, using the contact details on our Contact page. Depending on where you live you may have additional rights.
We may update this policy and will change the effective date when we do. Questions? Reach us through the Contact page.

Prospecting Call Tracker provides prospecting software and consulting for real estate professionals. Features, packages and pricing may change; the scope of any paid engagement is set out in your order or agreement. Packages do not include unlimited custom programming; custom work is scoped and quoted in advance.

We provide software, systems, training and consulting. We do not guarantee leads, appointments, listings, closings, savings or income. Results vary and depend on effort, market conditions, lead quality, and follow-up.
Some features rely on providers you connect or that we use, such as phone, texting, email, AI, lead data and hosting providers. Their fees may be separate and their terms also apply.

sections.h: Your responsibilities: calling, texting and email
p: You are responsible for how you use the software to contact people, including complying with telemarketing, texting and email laws (such as the TCPA, the Telephone Consumer Protection Act; Do Not Call rules; CAN-SPAM; and state laws), obtaining any required consent, scrubbing against Do Not Call lists, and honoring opt-outs. The software includes tools to help, but they don't replace your own compliance review.
You own the data you put into the software. You're responsible for having the right to upload and use it. We process it to provide the service as described in our Privacy Policy.
Don't misuse the services: no unlawful, harassing or deceptive outreach, no attempts to break security, and no reselling without permission.
AI drafts and suggestions may be inaccurate. Review them before use; a person must approve any AI-drafted message before it is sent.
The website and services are provided “as is” to the extent the law allows. Our liability is limited to the amount you paid us in the twelve months before the claim, to the extent the law allows.
We may update these terms and will change the effective date when we do. Questions? Reach us through the Contact page.
